context: NC Mo alloys with grain sizes larger than 13nm (up to 120nm ) were obtained by annealing the as-deposited Mo alloy at temperatures higher than 923K in the hydrogen atmosphere (Table 2). Fig. 1a shows the XRD patterns of specimens with grain sizes of 50 and 120nm . Although only bcc structure with no precipitation of other phases was detected, existence of porosity verified by SEM and TEM (Fig. 2d–f) is observed. This is due to the reduction of oxygen by hydrogen in the alloy occurring at the temperature above 923 K [21]. These specimens are labeled as porous in Table 2.
